flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi DataHiveUenFinService.findAlternativeAddress + createWorkItemForNoAlternativeAddress/createWorkItemForPRSC (placeholders, log only); ocmsadminui utils/Meta/WorkItem.ts, utils/data/LinkData.tsx (Work Items menu), pages/NoticeUPL/Hooks/useEndorsement.tsx (POST workitem for UPL only). No work item entity/endpoint in ocmsadminapi, no appeal data
note: Story status: No requirement (requirement not given), traced normally from the story text. The story asks for a work item containing the ID, notices and appeal details (including the alternative address from the appeal) to appear on the officer's dashboard. Work item creation in the code is a placeholder that only writes a log (DataHiveUenFinService.java:3697-3701; createWorkItemForPRSC :2920-2923); there is no ocms_work_item entity/table and no workitem handler in ocmsadminapi. The UI has a 'Work Items' menu (LinkData.tsx:170-176, WorkItem.ts:1-11) and a POST workitem only for UPL endorsement (useEndorsement.tsx:56,119-121), without a work item list page. The alternative address the code recognises comes from lta_reg/furnished_mail for foreigners (DataHiveUenFinService.java:3564-3600), not from appeals; its job is switched off in prod (cron-schedules-prod.properties:52). The real server value cannot be verified from the repo.
recommendation: Not claimed: no requirement was given and work item creation + dashboard do not exist (log-only placeholder). Only recognising a foreigner's alternative address from internal data can be mentioned as groundwork

steps.step: OCMS identifies an alternative address that is different from the registered address
steps.detail: findAlternativeAddress takes lta_reg (error_code 0) or furnished_mail from ocms_offence_notice_owner_driver_addr for a foreigner when DataHive returns no address (DataHiveUenFinService.java:3564-3600, called at :2566-2576). That address is not compared with the registered address, its source is not an appeal, 'set as default address' is not implemented, and the DataHive UEN/FIN job is switched off in prod (cron-schedules-prod.properties:52; the real server value cannot be verified from the repo).

steps.step: OCMS creates a work item containing the ID, notices and appeal details
steps.detail: createWorkItemForNoAlternativeAddress and createWorkItemForPRSC are PLACEHOLDERS that only log '[PLACEHOLDER] Work item creation skipped' (DataHiveUenFinService.java:3697-3701, :2920-2923). There is no ocms_work_item entity/table or workitem handler in ocmsadminapi/ocmsadminprivateapi (grep for work item finds nothing besides the placeholders and the HST statistics report), and there is no appeal data to put in.

steps.step: The work item includes the alternative address from the appeal
steps.detail: There is no work item payload and no address-from-appeal field; appeal data never enters OCMS (see OCMS20.14). createWorkItemForNoAlternativeAddress takes only noticeNo (DataHiveUenFinService.java:3697).

steps.step: The work item is routed to the officer's dashboard for follow-up
steps.detail: A 'Work Items' menu with path /work-item exists (LinkData.tsx:170-176, WorkItem.ts:1-11) but there is no work item list route/page in App.tsx; the only user of POST workitem is UPL endorsement (useEndorsement.tsx:56,119-121) and ocmsadminapi has no workitem handler. There is no allocation of a work item to an officer or dashboard view for the alternative address case.
